name: Germanium Mining Corp.
summary: Germanium Mining Corp. engages in the acquisition, exploration, and evaluation of mineral properties in Canada. The company explores for nickel, cobalt, copper, zinc, germanium, gold, lithium, and uranium deposits. It holds an option agreement to acquire a 100% interest in the Lac du Km 35 Germanium property that consists of 75 mineral claims covering an area of approximately 4,150 hectares located in Quebec, as well as an interest in the Pluto Gold Prospect located in the Chapais Township, Quebec. The company was formerly known as Musk Metals Corp. and changed its name to Germanium Mining Corp. in June 2025. Germanium Mining Corp. was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
